notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
You control at least five creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one land card in your graveyard.
description:
Declare at least five creatures you control as attackers.
Grand Warlord Radha triggers, adding at least {R}{R}{R/G}{R/G}{R/G}.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Kirri triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R}{R} and discarding a land card, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
